title: Flat-64-convention gated Phase-0 Vandermonde Y-cluster joint-2X 5-window 1-chain split-word birthday search on secp256k1 at 123.280411577789137

claims.statement: For uniform secp256k1 Q=[x]P, the classical cold gated grouped stored-leaf birthday search of proof.md recovers x w.p. >= 0.39 (Q=O => x=0). Coord 0 draws 128-bit RNDR u (GATE=256 insns), halting with no output unless u < K_GATE = 132876778476359327461665228784829061972 (p_gate=K_GATE/2^128 ~ 0.390489756), else running Phase-0 GF(1024) X-mining (E_mine <= 2^124.3369 insns, halting via psel if any pool < 4 valid 0 < A(V)-A(U) < 2^63 pairs in B_p; no padding) and q1=70,000,000,000 batches in G=2048 groups (m_g=floor(q1*(g/2048)^(25/32))) on 2^66 generators (MX=8), 2^41 relays, 2^82 homes (CAP_H=1,313,229,200,424,960). Opened-run lo_run >= 0.998873834385 ((K_GATE/2^128)*lo_run >= 0.39005 > 0.39, c21). Unconditional E_total = 256 + p_gate*E_run (charging Phase-0 aborts at E_mine + 0 Phase 1-4 work and E_exc at EXC_WORK) is <= 2^123.280411577789137 units of 1000 scalar AArch64 insns (E_run <= 2^124.637055 units, <= 63.6428 insns/leaf of S=2^128.610916); memory <= 2^138.0001 B; pre <= 2^115.7543 units (in E_run); no advice or prior-verdict premises. The count holds under proof.md section 2's flat 64-bit address convention (analytical instruction-equivalents: each backed address below 2^64 costs one counted load/store; Armv9-A physical addresses have at most 56 bits, so not a hardware-layout claim).

experiments.purpose: Checks Y-chain generation, MX=8 Phase-0 birthday 5-window 1-chain split-word leaf kernels incl. straddling close pairs, flat-64-convention K1=256/K2B=512 nodes with read-only cluster-shared YR, wcnt wait, meter_skip_ok, Phase-0 xemit/dlvh/hhclr and psel abort + mutant rejection, address trace, gate, Vandermonde/CS, C132 fold bound, and certificate counts.
